s.note: the long ride north to Wyoming
s.how: Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp, chop and keep the fat in the pan. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, an egg and 300ml buttermilk. Stir in the bacon, pour into the hot greased pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Serve with butter.

Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Heat 250ml white vinegar with the juice from a can of beetroot, 2 tbsp sugar, a teaspoon of mustard seeds and peppercorns. Pour over the eggs in a jar with the beetroot and pickle in the fridge for 3 days.

m.n: Rainy night beef and bean stew
m.note: sheltering from the rain on the trail
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a sliced onion, crushed garlic and 2 crumbled dried chillies. Pour in a can of crushed tomatoes and water to cover. Braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 2 cans of drained kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.

w.n: Big Whiskey bread pudding, whiskey sauce
w.note: Greeley's saloon in Big Whiskey, Wyoming
w.how: Tear 400g day-old bread into a buttered dish with 80g raisins. Whisk 4 eggs, 600ml milk, 120g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon, pour over and soak 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 45 minutes until set and golden. Melt 80g butter with 100g brown sugar and 100ml cream, simmer 2 minutes and stir in 40ml whiskey. Pour over the warm pudding to serve.

d.note: the whiskey Munny swore off, until he doesn't
d.how: Bring 1L water to the boil in a pot, stir in 60g coarse ground coffee and simmer 2 minutes. Take off the heat, splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds and rest 3 minutes. Lightly whip 150ml cream until just thick. Put 2 tsp brown sugar and 30ml whiskey in each of four mugs, pour in the coffee carefully and stir. Spoon the cream over the back of a spoon to float it on top.
